title: Power of attorney for payments | EC Assets
description: Power of attorney granted to EC Assets for payment processing with its e-money partner.

blocks.text: Power of attorney for payment processing

blocks.html: This is a structural placeholder for the mockup. The final wording must come from EC Assets' legal counsel before publication.
By ordering a product with a payment component, you grant EC Assets a limited power of attorney towards its e-money partner.

The power of attorney allows EC Assets to open and manage an e-money account in your name with its licensed e-money partner, to initiate payouts from your Blocked Account and to close the account when the contract ends.
EC Assets may not use the power of attorney for any purpose other than delivering the products you ordered. It ends automatically when your contract with EC Assets ends.
You can revoke the power of attorney at any time in text form. Revocation may make it impossible to deliver the product.
